summary: Fix continuous offline voice typing across successive transcription batches.

changes.title: Keep tap-to-dictate recording across batches
changes.detail: Synchronize live voice composition and expected editor cursor in one RichInputConnection batch edit. Own interim selection updates no longer reset the composing span. Capture and queued transcription continue until explicit Stop or the existing 170-second safety cap; Incognito, hold-to-talk and cancel rules remain unchanged. Regression tests cover multiple live batches and two minutes of continuous PCM.

changes.title: Keep recording if an editor rejects live composition
changes.detail: If an editor rejects an interim composing update, continue collecting and decoding audio and defer guarded transcript delivery until Stop. Preserve the installed offline model, privacy checks and signing identity.
